items.source: ReferenceResolver implementation that uses a given ReferenceLookupDelegate to load and convert entity associations expressed via a persitent property. Creates proxies for associations that should be lazily loaded.
items.translation: 实现ReferenceResolver接口，利用给定的ReferenceLookupDelegate来加载和转换通过persistent property表示的实体关联。为需要延迟加载的关联创建proxies。

items.source: Resolve the association defined via the given property from a given source value. May return a proxy instance in case of a lazy loading association. The resolved value is assignable to PersistentProperty.getType().
items.translation: 解析通过给定属性定义的关联，从给定的源值中获取。如果是懒加载关联，可能会返回一个代理实例。解析后的值可赋值给PersistentProperty.getType()。
